content:
I’m excited to share that I’ve joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC)**!  

I’ve been working with CDS Hooks since **2017**, and it’s been amazing to see how far the standard has come. I’m looking forward to helping move CDS Hooks forward and continue strengthening clinical decision support interoperability across the ecosystem.  

If you’re already using CDS Hooks, please consider adding your implementation to the community list here:  
👉 https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability  

And if you’re not using CDS Hooks yet—but are interested in integrating it into your products or workflows—I’m available as a **freelance consultant** to support you with:  
- Architecture and design  
- Implementation guidance  
- Best practices and governance  

Feel free to reach out if you’d like to discuss how CDS Hooks can fit into your roadmap.
